comment: Single source of truth for host-side registry value redaction. Copied byte-for-byte to vajranet_server backend/src/utils/fim/fimRedactionPolicy.json; both test suites pin its canonical SHA-256. Names are ASCII lower-case. mandatory: always redacted. secretLike: substrings that redact a value name unless it is listed in exempt (non-secret security settings whose changes must stay visible). Custom entries additionally redact (digest marker) every value whose NAME contains a character outside printable ASCII: host-side lower() is ASCII-only, so localized names (Kennwort with umlauts, Cyrillic, CJK) cannot be matched by substring.
